svg.title: Two pods take the same order: before
svg.desc: The buyer's app sends checkout for order 42 twice. Copy A reaches pod 1 and copy B reaches pod 2. Each pod reads the order's status, sees PENDING, and calls the payment provider, because neither pod has written anything yet. The provider charges the card for A and again for B. Each pod then marks the order PAID in a short transaction, and both copies get 200 OK, so one order has been charged twice.
svg.text: Before: read the status, then charge
The same checkout for order 42 reaches two pods. Each reads PENDING before either one writes, so both charge the card.

g.text: throws if a caller's transaction is open
SELECT the status, go on if PENDING
the other pod can still read PENDING
charging the card again for B
Both pods read PENDING, so the provider charged the card twice for order 42.
Neither pod wrote anything until its charge came back, so neither status check could see the other.

svg.text: Sources: quarkus.io/guides/transaction (declarative approach) and postgresql.org/docs (Read Committed isolation level).
